column1: # need_mib here is carried from the sibling BASELINE combination's MEASURED
# llamacpp-opencode/profiles.tsv). It is a CONSERVATIVE bound, not a Swift
# measurement: that baseline carried a 1.57 GiB MTP sidecar that Swift does not
# (Swift's MTP head is built into the GGUF), so Swift's real headroom at each
# profile is ~1.5 GiB BETTER than the bound shows. The pre-flight therefore
# errs safe -- it will never under-reserve. The cost is that the tightest
# profiles may be nudged down a notch earlier than they strictly need to be.
# Re-run the context probe on this install to replace these bounds with real
# Swift numbers (see benchmarks/README.md). Until then, trust `coding` (plenty
# of slack under the bound) and treat `vision-max` / `max` as foreground-only.
